extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent attorneys/agents, national patent office staff, and WIPO member states
extracted.subtask_description: The Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) text listing the articles and chapters that set out procedural and substantive rules governing international patent applications, searches, preliminary examination, publication, national phase, and administrative/technical processes under the PCT system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preamble
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This capture contains the table of contents only; the preamble sets out the treaty's purposes and context in the full text. Consult the full treaty text for substantive formulation of objectives and interpretive context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introductory Provisions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Introductory provisions define scope and application—see full treaty text for definitions and initial requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 1 — Establishment of a Union
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article specifies the legal establishment and membership framework for the PCT union.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 2 — Definitions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article contains key legal definitions used throughout the treaty (e.g., international application, receiving Office, designated/elected Office).

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 3 — The International Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. The full article sets out what constitutes an international application and basic content requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 4 — The Request
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article details requirements for the request form included in an international application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 5 — The Description
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article prescribes content and form standards for the description portion of an international application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 6 — The Claims
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article provides requirements for claims (form, number, clarity, support) used to define the scope of protection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 7 — The Drawings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article sets standards for drawings, when required and their form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 8 — Claiming Priority
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article governs claiming priority from earlier national or regional filings, including time limits and evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 9 — The Applicant
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article addresses who may be applicant(s), change of applicant, and related formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 10 — The Receiving Office
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article outlines tasks, responsibilities, and requirements of receiving Offices that accept international applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 11 — Filing Date and Effects of the International Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Article 11 Filing Date and Effects of the International Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article defines how filing dates are established and legal effects resulting from the international filing date.

rubrics_metrics.description: Article 12 Transmittal of the International Application to the International Bureau and the International Searching Authority
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article specifies transmission procedures and timeframes for sending the application to IB and ISA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 13 — Availability of Copy of the International Application to Designated Offices
rubrics_metrics.description: Article 13 Availability of Copy of the International Application to Designated Offices
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article governs availability and distribution of copies to designated national/regional offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 14 — Certain Defects in the International Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Article 14 Certain Defects in the International Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article lists types of defects that can be rectified and procedures for correction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 15 — The International Search
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article describes the international search process and scope performed by an ISA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 16 — The International Searching Authority
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article sets criteria and functions of ISAs and their authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 17 — Procedure Before the International Searching Authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Article 17 Procedure Before the International Searching Authority
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article prescribes procedural steps and deadlines in interactions with the ISA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 18 — The International Search Report
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article explains content, form and communication of the ISR and its legal/technical effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 19 — Amendment of the Claims Before the International Bureau
rubrics_metrics.description: Article 19 Amendment of the Claims Before the International Bureau
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article describes procedures and limits for amending claims at the IB stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 20 — Communication to Designated Offices
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article governs what communications (search report, publications, etc.) are sent to designated offices and how.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 21 — International Publication
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article sets timing, content, and effects of international publication of the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 22 — Copy, Translation, and Fee, to Designated Offices
rubrics_metrics.description: Article 22 Copy, Translation, and Fee, to Designated Offices
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article details national-phase copy/translation obligations and fee requirements to designated/elected offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 23 — Delaying of National Procedure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article explains circumstances and effects when national/regional procedures are to be delayed following PCT processing.

rubrics_metrics.description: Article 24 Possible Loss of Effect in Designated States
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article sets conditions under which international filing may lose effect in designated states (e.g., failure to comply with requirements).

rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article covers obligations and discretion of designated national/regional offices in reviewing international applications entering national phase.

rubrics_metrics.description: Article 26 Opportunity to Correct Before Designated Offices
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article permits applicants to correct deficiencies when entering national phase per national/regional practice.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article states the interplay between PCT procedures and individual national/regional legal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.description: Article 28 Amendment of the Claims, the Description, and the Drawings, Before Designated Offices
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article specifies when and how amendments may be made in the national phase before designated/elected offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article 29 — Effects of the International Publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Article 29 Effects of the International Publication
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article addresses legal consequences of international publication for prior art, provisional protection, etc.

rubrics_metrics.description: Article 30 Confidential Nature of the International Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC only. Full article sets rules on confidentiality during certain phases and exceptions (e.g., publication).

rubrics_metrics.description: Article 34 Procedure Before the International Preliminary Examining Authority

rubrics_metrics.description: Article 35 The International Preliminary Examination Report

rubrics_metrics.description: Article 38 Confidential Nature of the International Preliminary Examination
